column1: # Sources for assemble_supplementary_figures.py: one panel per line.
# figure = final number (first citation in the text, 2026-10-12); was = the
# frozen figure-map number it replaces; panel = short name used in the copy's
# file name; path = the panel's SVG (PDF and PNG with the same stem are copied
# too). Relative paths resolve against --base-dir (PROJECT_DIR, the miniprot
# directory); ${POPGEN_DIR} is exported by the wrapper. Point a line at a newer
# run here; renumber by editing the figure column. S15 of the frozen map was
# vacated (its content is supplementary table S2). S1 and S4 point at the
# 2026-10-14 reruns with boxes from every gene: if those ran on another day,
# change the date in those four lines.
# 2026-10-26 (Jianbin Wang's review): the Ascaris dN/dS genome trace, main Fig 3
# until then, joins S6 as its first panel, so S6 holds dN/dS, dN and dS for all
# three species. S4 points at the 2026-10-26 codon reruns (scatter pair first,
# both centroids filled); if those ran on another day, change 20261027 there.
